title: Compile-time types vs runtime values
description: Secure compile-time types vs runtime values boundaries through runtime validation, typed results and local TypeScript tests rather than trusting erased annotations.
objectives: Distinguish static typing from runtime trust in compile-time types vs runtime values
Validate unknown input or normalize transport data before constructing a domain value
Verify rejected and accepted cases with runnable tests plus compiler checks
rubric: I can identify the untrusted runtime boundary in compile-time types vs runtime values.
I reject at least one malformed input and validate one successful case.
I avoid unchecked type assertions in public API contracts.
